findings.quote: Alpha particles are heavy and stopped by a sheet of paper or by the outer layer of dead skin. Beta particles go farther and are stopped by a thin sheet of aluminum.
findings.problem: Still open from round 1. This paragraph has five sentences, above the one-to-three limit. Four-sentence paragraphs remain at 'Two numbers describe a nucleus.', 'An electron has $A=0$ and $Z=-1$.', 'The released neutrons can strike more uranium-$235$ nuclei.' and 'Nuclei carry positive charge and push each other away.'
